! JO9 MOD START MAID_DUTY_SELECTOR | 2026-10-19_maid_duty_selection
! Returns one checked, available actor. Uses current raw skill; ties are random.
! args[0]: cook, clean, tentacle. Optional args[1]: actor to exclude after refusal.
$result=''
local $jo9_rule, $jo9_skill, $jo9_role, $jo9_winner, $jo9_roles
local jo9_i, jo9_state, jo9_energy, jo9_enabled, jo9_value, jo9_best, jo9_ties, jo9_eligible
$jo9_winner=''
jo9_best=-999
jo9_ties=0
if $args[0]='cook':
 if kitchen<=0 or cooked_food>0 or ate_already>=max(1,master_str): exit
 $jo9_rule='cooks_rule' & $jo9_skill='cook'
elseif $args[0]='clean':
 if house_mess<=1: exit
 $jo9_rule='cleans_rule' & $jo9_skill='service'
elseif $args[0]='tentacle':
 if pet_tentacle<=0 or (tentacle_state!1 and spawn_milked!0): exit
 $jo9_rule='tentacle_rule' & $jo9_skill='sub_tentacles'
else
 exit
end
$jo9_roles[0]='slave'
$jo9_roles[1]='assistant'
$jo9_roles[2]='room1'
$jo9_roles[3]='room2'
$jo9_roles[4]='room3'
$jo9_roles[5]='room4'
for jo9_i=0 to 5 step 1:
 $jo9_role=$jo9_roles[jo9_i]
 jo9_state=dyneval('result='+$jo9_role+'_state')
 jo9_energy=dyneval('result='+$jo9_role+'["energy"]')
 jo9_enabled=dyneval('result='+$jo9_role+'["'+$jo9_rule+'"]')
 jo9_value=dyneval('result='+$jo9_role+'["'+$jo9_skill+'"]')
 jo9_eligible=iif(jo9_state=CONST_INT['slave_exist'] and jo9_energy>=0 and jo9_enabled=1 and $jo9_role!$args[1],1,0)
 if $jo9_role='slave':
  if $args[0]='cook' and slave['obedience'] < -6 + iif(slave['pride'] > 2, -2, 0) + iif(slave['ego'] < 3, 1, 0) + iif(slave['intellect'] < 3, 1, 0): jo9_eligible=0
  if $args[0]='clean' and slave['obedience'] < -5 + iif(slave['stamina'] < 3, 1, -1) + iif(slave['intellect'] > 2, 1, -1) + iif(slave['pride'] > 2, slave['pride'] - 2, slave['pride'] - 3) + iif(slave['pride'] > 2, -2, 0) + iif(slave['ego'] < 3, 1, 0) + iif(slave['intellect'] < 3, 1, 0): jo9_eligible=0
 end
 if $args[0]='tentacle' and $jo9_role='assistant' and jo9_value<=0: jo9_eligible=0
 if jo9_eligible=1:
  if jo9_value>jo9_best:
   jo9_best=jo9_value & jo9_ties=1 & $jo9_winner=$jo9_role
  elseif jo9_value=jo9_best:
   jo9_ties+=1
   if rand(1,jo9_ties)=1: $jo9_winner=$jo9_role
  end
 end
end
$result=$jo9_winner
! JO9 MOD END MAID_DUTY_SELECTOR
